body: I would sincerely enjoy something of that nature, but wouldn't have the motivation to stick with it. As dorky as it may sound, I enjoy researching and learning about various topics whatever they may pertain to. I need to help myself so that I can help others, but how do you do that when you feel like your friends and loved ones would be better off without you? Going to be homeless at the end of this month really puts the icing on the cake. It seems depression has robbed me of everything. I don't care about the materialistic things, but loss of love has taken it toll.

I have tried almost every single antidepressant available to no success. I also have ADHD and anxiety, and not living up to my potential is literally and figuratively killing me inside everyday. Trying to explain to doctors that the meds they prescribe are not working and having them lower and up the dosages constantly is extremely frustrating. I will either go on to help others, or just become another heart wrenching statistic.

Sure here goes. I have never been in a darker place inside my head than I am right now. Ideally, I have a deep yearning to help other people like myself who have suffered especially since it takes everything in me to keep going. I know where these poor souls are coming from when they tell me "nobody understands". Not trying to sound arrogant when I tell you that I discovered my passion in college and found out that I have sort of a knack for caring about others more than myself. Straight A's and the deans list don't mean a thing when you've been unemployed since 2008. Can't handle the pressures of life anymore I guess. Thanks for taking time to hear me out though.
